[7:32PM] #Mushin #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic in Mushin is moving smoothly on several routes, including Moshalasi to Ojuwoye Post Office, Ilupeju bypass to Olupese, and the return journey from Bolade to Moshalasi. 
However, there's a slow but steady movement under the Oshodi bridge towards Brown Junction.
Officers are on ground managing traffic, and no impediments have been reported, keeping everything under control.
